addr: 552, 16th Main, 15th Cross Rd, Sector 4, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: Cozy little space, minimal decor, comfy ambience. I had The Toasted One, a coffee with coconut milk poured over, which was on a summer special menu. Their lemon cake was soft and light, not overly sweet. Good find!
The cafe is so aesthetic and the coffee is so on point, I tried the mocha latte which was too good and the french press coffee was pretty strong, the banana cake was tasty.
Quiet, cozy cafe in HSR. I would suggest the barrel aged cold brew and the hot chocolate here. Both are incredibly good!
